sents.t: At six on Saturday morning, we left Oakville.
The sun was rising, and Lily was singing along to her playlist.
For hours, we drove past farms, small towns, and endless fields of corn.
I have never seen so much flat land in my life!
At noon, we stopped at a gas station.
While I was filling up the tank, Lily was buying coffee and snacks.
Then she took the wheel, and I took a nap.
Around three o’clock, we were driving through Nebraska when the sky suddenly turned dark.
It was raining so hard that we couldn’t see the road.
Lily pulled over at a rest area, and we waited for half an hour.
While we were waiting, we played word games.
When the rain stopped, there was a double rainbow over the fields.
We arrived at the motel at seven.
It was old but clean, and the owner was a friendly woman with a big dog.
She recommended a diner across the street.
We ate the biggest burgers of our lives and drank chocolate milkshakes.
That night, I was asleep before ten.

comp.q: What was Lily doing when they left?
comp.fa: وقتی راه افتادند لیلی چه کار می‌کرد؟

comp.q: What was Lily doing while Sam was filling up the tank?
comp.fa: وقتی سام باک را پر می‌کرد لیلی چه کار می‌کرد؟
حدود ساعت سه چه اتفاقی افتاد؟

comp.q: What did they see when the rain stopped?
comp.fa: وقتی باران بند آمد چه دیدند؟

o: a man at the gas station
comp.fa: چه کسی آن غذاخوری را پیشنهاد داد؟

comp.q: What time did Sam fall asleep?
